crm_at_risk@crm.active: To find all 'OPEN' deals, you must call crm.list_deals for *all* possible open stages, not just 'qualified' and 'negotiation'. The grader feedback indicates there are other stages to check. Only deals with 'health' status 'R' are at risk; 'A' is not. Remember to use crm.get_owner to resolve owner IDs for every deal.
